scope: Absolute deadlines for private host exchanges; real Unix sockets on macOS and Linux, synthetic LUKS/systemd/QEMU regressions on Mac ARM/HVF with nested TCG.
network: Offline; no external provider requests or real credentials.

implementation.mechanism: One monotonic Instant per exchange; read/write calls use its remaining budget and check expiry after I/O. Interrupted or early kernel timeouts never renew it.
implementation.qmp: Greeting, capabilities, command and all intermediate events share a five-second deadline, including buffered events.
implementation.session_token: QMP resume, token request, token delivery and ready acknowledgement share sixty seconds after grant.
implementation.storage: One ten-second admission deadline for length, JSON and secret. Worker execution is separate. Response send has ten seconds; manager waits at most 120 seconds for the full response.
implementation.gateway: Five-second root-only frame admission; ten-second worker request/acknowledgement (thirty for stop); thirty seconds per supervisor operation; sixty seconds for boot readiness.
implementation.failure: Incomplete storage requests are rejected before dispatch. Gateway channel errors terminate the owner and destroy its VM. A timeout never declares a LUKS mapping closed.

real_admission_faults: UID 1000 sends an incomplete JSON frame with one-byte progress each second; controller rejects it.
UID 1000 sends an incomplete secret with one-byte progress each second; controller rejects it and serves a subsequent valid status request.
Root-only gateway client sends an incomplete frame with one-byte progress each second; the owner exits, its VM stops and storage state remains explicit.

limits: Deadlines start after Unix socket connection and do not bound subprocesses, cryptsetup, filesystem calls or the complete lifecycle operation.
Manager timeout does not cancel a dispatched storage worker; recovery must inspect actual state.
Gateway-internal API-child handshake and provider HTTP timing are not changed.
No dedicated hostile QMP event flood or fragmented token guest in this run; their shared Channel is exercised with real socket fragmentation and the normal VM flow.
Pidfd observation can be delayed by bounded in-flight IPC; no instantaneous revocation or physical scheduling guarantee.
Synthetic marker scans do not prove universal absence of writes or physical RAM erasure.
remaining_gates: Full adapter streaming/tool calling, active upstream cancellation and authorized Abliteration/Tor tests.
Tool proxy, Wi-Fi/bridges, file transfers/OnionShare, full ephemeral sessions and TUI refinement.
I/O failures, power loss, OOM, full shutdown, signed live image, hardware and independent audit.
